instruction: Set up a Thunderbird filter to mark all emails with subject containing 'Newsletter' as read automatically. Configure this locally in Thunderbird only.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a filter to automatically mark emails as read based on subject content. The evaluator verifies an enabled filter with 'Mark Read' action exists.
